baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction تُقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ نَجْوَاكُمْ صَدَقَاتٍ places a material act immediately before private speech.
baseline_models.mechanism: Advancing charity before privileged consultation turns claimed sincerity into an observable cost before speech receives special access.

activation_trace.role: Forward precedence supplies the temporal motion of placing an act ahead of speech.
The between-the-hands image locates the gift directly before the near encounter.
Secret consultation supplies the privileged speech event being approached.
The monetary charity branch supplies the concrete cost.
Truth realized in action makes the cost an enactment of sincerity rather than a bare fee.

changed_reading.before: A fee is required before a private consultation.
changed_reading.after: A material gift makes sincerity costly and visible before one claims privileged private speech.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opening interrogative أَأَشْفَقْتُمْ governs the refusal to advance charities.
baseline_models.mechanism: The question holds together apprehensive care and parsimonious holding back, testing whether concern over cost became refusal to advance generosity.

activation_trace.role: Care mixed with fear supplies an apprehensive motive rather than simple hostility.
Holding back through stinginess supplies the sharper economic diagnosis within that apprehension.
Bold advance supplies the action from which the hesitant addressees recoil.
Material charity identifies what apprehension risks withholding.

changed_reading.before: The addressees merely feared a difficult command.
changed_reading.after: The interrogative probes a mixed motive in which protective concern can shade into withholding when generosity must precede access.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: After لَمْ تَفْعَلُوا the ayah pivots through فَأَقِيمُوا، وَآتُوا، وَأَطِيعُوا and closes with بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Failure at one discrete threshold is answered by standing up recurring worship, transfer, and obedience, so cancellation does not terminate action but converts it into durable practice.

activation_trace.role: A particular enacted deed marks the failed one-time performance.
Sustaining and guarding turns prayer into maintained practice.
Specified worship supplies the recurring vertical practice.
Growth and increase make almsgiving a continuing circulatory practice.
Compliant movement supplies continued alignment beyond the waived act.
Intentional work broadens the close from one omitted deed to an ongoing field of action.

changed_reading.before: The special charity is canceled and ordinary duties are restated.
changed_reading.after: A failed one-time threshold is converted into maintained worship, redistribution, obedience, and accountable work.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening complaint and dialogue are already heard by God, so the focus gift regulates costly human private access rather than purchasing divine audibility.

activation_trace.role: Repeated auditory reception makes divine hearing prior to any access payment.
Voiced complaint supplies a need that reaches hearing without a preliminary gift.
Reciprocal speech makes the opening audience dialogic rather than purchased.
Private consultation anchors the revised model in the focus access event.
Knowledge of inward matters confirms that divine awareness is not gated by payment.

structural_cues: The surah opens with one complainant's dialogue being heard before the later rules for private consultation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies already-heard complaint and dialogue; I infer a distinction between unlimited divine hearing and limited human audience time; alternatively, the opening may establish omniscience without commenting on access allocation.

changed_reading.before: Charity is the price of being heard in private.
changed_reading.after: Charity disciplines use of a limited human audience while divine hearing remains immediately available.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier material remediation must precede restored bodily proximity; the focus repeats that architecture for communicative proximity, placing a material release before private approach.

activation_trace.role: Liberation supplies a costly remedial act that changes another person's material condition.
Precedence makes remediation explicitly earlier than restored proximity.
Marital contact supplies the relational proximity held back until repair occurs.
Advancing beforehand reproduces the prior-act sequence in the focus.
Near frontal placement turns private consultation into approached proximity.
Charity supplies the focus's materially reparative release.

structural_cues: The earlier rule orders liberation before marital contact; the focus orders charity before private consultation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two material-before-proximity sequences; I infer a shared repair architecture moving from bodily to communicative access; alternatively, the repeated precedence may be only legal sequencing without cross-domain force.

changed_reading.before: The consultation gift is an isolated procedural toll.
changed_reading.after: It participates in a wider pattern where material repair must precede restoration of relational proximity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Witness, encompassing knowledge, and the counted private gathering remove any equation between secrecy and invisibility; the preliminary gift occurs before speech already exposed to divine knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Presence with observation supplies an encompassing witness to action.
Private consultation is explicitly placed inside the witnessed gathering.
Disclosure to the knower removes informational concealment from the private exchange.
Knowledge of the interior closes the focus with the same exposure.
Intentional work makes conduct, not merely uttered content, answerable within that exposure.

structural_cues: The numbered private gathering in 58:7 is followed by notification of what its participants did.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies witness, knowledge, and private gatherings; I infer that the gift externalizes accountability before speech that is already seen; alternatively, awareness may function only as a general warning.

changed_reading.before: Private consultation creates a protected unseen zone.
changed_reading.after: Private consultation remains inside witnessed space, and the prior gift makes that accountability materially visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same medium of private speech can coordinate transgression or expansive good; requiring a truthful material act before privileged consultation adds friction that selects for beneficial counsel.

activation_trace.role: Repeated secret consultation supplies the morally variable medium.
Crossing a limit supplies the harmful coordination that private speech can carry.
Expansive good supplies the constructive alternative content for consultation.
Protective avoidance supplies the boundary against harmful use of the medium.
Truth realized in action makes charity a sincerity filter on proposed counsel.
Obedient alignment identifies the direction into which private coordination is redirected.

structural_cues: 58:8 and 58:9 contrast forbidden and commanded uses of the same repeated consultation form.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies harmful and beneficial branches of private coordination; I infer that advance charity acts as behavioral friction favoring serious good counsel; alternatively, it may honor the audience without screening content.

changed_reading.before: Private speech is suspect, so access is taxed.
changed_reading.after: Private speech is morally variable, and a costly truthful act filters privileged counsel toward beneficial coordination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Commands to open public space and rise when called frame the later private audience as a scarce shared resource; advance charity discourages monopolizing that space for low-cost private claims.

activation_trace.role: Opened capacity supplies a public norm of making room for others.
Rising and moving from the sitting place supplies responsive relinquishment of occupied space.
Elevation of rank separates true elevation from mere physical proximity to the audience.
Intervening space anchors the access mechanism in the focus construction.
Private consultation supplies the exclusive use of shared attention.
A material gift imposes a cost on exclusive access while benefiting beyond the speaker.

structural_cues: Public assembly etiquette immediately precedes the command governing private audience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opened seating, responsive rising, and then private access; I infer one economy of shared space and attention; alternatively, the adjacent commands may regulate unrelated settings.

changed_reading.before: The charity concerns only the individual consultant's piety.
changed_reading.after: It also protects fair use of shared attention by making exclusive access costly and socially productive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prior ayah already exempts lack of means, whereas the focus names failure to act; its mercy therefore addresses exposed nonperformance without collapsing poverty into reluctance.

activation_trace.role: Means and sufficiency make material inability an explicit prior category.
Protective covering of fault supplies mercy for the unable.
Tender mercy prevents the inability clause from becoming exclusion.
Holding back supplies a motive distinct from simply lacking means.
The focus names the deed's nonoccurrence rather than repeating inability language.

structural_cues: 58:12 says 'if you do not find,' while 58:13 says 'when you did not do.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinct inability and nonperformance clauses; I infer that the shift diagnoses reluctance while preserving mercy; alternatively, the clauses may be stylistic restatements of the same exemption.

changed_reading.before: The requirement is lifted because everyone lacked resources.
changed_reading.after: Material inability was already protected; the focus mercifully exposes and redirects a broader failure to act.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prior gift is named beneficial and purifying; when its one-time form is lifted, prayer, almsgiving, and obedience distribute those functions across recurring communal life.

activation_trace.role: Movement toward beneficial good supplies the gift's stated social direction.
Cleansing conduct of ugliness supplies the gift's transformative function.
Maintenance carries the function from a single threshold into an established practice.
Recurring worship supplies one durable channel for the redirected formation.
Purity and rectitude carry the prior gift's cleansing function into regular almsgiving.
Ongoing compliance extends purification into the full field of conduct.

structural_cues: The labels 'better' and 'purer' immediately precede the focus pivot to established prayer, zakah, and obedience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the gift's good and purifying qualities followed by recurring commands; I infer functional redistribution after the special form is lifted; alternatively, the commands may simply replace it without inheriting its function.

changed_reading.before: Mercy abolishes the failed purifying demand.
changed_reading.after: Mercy removes its one-time access form while redistributing its good and purifying work into durable practices.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later false oaths operate as protective cover; the focus charity opposes that economy by requiring truth to become costly action before privileged speech, under knowledge of deeds.

activation_trace.role: The oath supplies solemn speech capable of being used without corresponding truth.
Direct falsehood supplies the break between verbal claim and reality.
A protective shield supplies the function that repeated oaths perform for concealed conduct.
Truthful speech supplies the semantic opposite of the later false oaths.
Truth realized in action joins claim and deed before consultation.
Knowledge of inner reality makes verbal cover ineffective.
Intentional work makes actual conduct the closing object of scrutiny.

structural_cues: The focus closes on known deeds; the following unit moves from false oaths to oaths explicitly taken as a shield.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies truth-action branches, false oaths, and shielding; I infer that costly giving punctures cheap verbal self-presentation; alternatively, the two units may address separate forms of obedience.

changed_reading.before: The gift is merely an entrance payment before speaking.
changed_reading.after: The gift is an anti-shield: a costly joining of word and deed before speech can claim privileged standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence makes hostile capture produce neglected remembrance; the focus's maintained prayer and obedience therefore function as recurrent resistance to capture after the one-time gift is waived.

activation_trace.role: Overpowering possession supplies the external capture that redirects conduct.
Neglect and abandonment supply the practical effect of that capture.
Bringing something back to presence supplies what recurring practice must preserve.
Guarded maintenance makes the replacement practices recurrent rather than episodic.
Specified worship supplies the repeated practice that counters neglect.
Obedient movement supplies resistance to being redirected by another controlling force.

structural_cues: The waived one-time act is followed by recurring commands; later, domination is described as causing abandonment of remembrance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies capture, forgetting, remembrance, and maintained worship; I infer that recurring practice is anti-forgetting infrastructure; alternatively, the focus commands may be general duties without this prospective function.

changed_reading.before: Prayer and obedience are generic duties appended after a concession.
changed_reading.after: Their recurrence is the durable safeguard against capture and practical forgetting once the single access test disappears.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus surface denotes charities, not a marriage contract. It remains branch-anchored in the SDQ dower image and is activated by the surrounding marriage and contact material; downstream prose should call it only a dower-like relational earnest, never identify the legal gift as a dowry.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus word صَدَقَاتٍ carries the packet's صَداق المرأة branch while standing before private relational access.

activation_trace.role: The dower branch supplies a material earnest marking seriousness before relational access.
Private consultation supplies the intimate speech relation approached by the earnest.
Marriage supplies the nearby relational domain that activates the distant SDQ branch.
Marital contact reinforces the pattern of a prior material act before intimate access.

changed_reading.before: The charity is only an impersonal levy.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also behaves like a relational earnest that materializes seriousness before intimate private speech.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading uses a non-dominant mapped root and a race image, so it is too form-distant to replace the ordinary senses of divine turning or prayer. It remains anchored in packet-supplied branches at the focus pivot; downstream prose should present it only as a kinetic analogy of reset, straightening, and resumed following.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: At the focus pivot, تَابَ is followed by أَقِيمُوا الصلاة and أَطِيعُوا after the failed advance.

activation_trace.role: The split-root image of straightening, readiness, and continuation supplies a course reset after failure.
Straightness and balance extend the reset into the command to establish.
Following the forerunner in a race supplies resumed ordered movement.
Compliant motion carries the reset forward as continued alignment.

changed_reading.before: Divine turning only cancels the failed requirement.
changed_reading.after: As a contained kinetic analogy, divine turning resets a stalled advance into straightened, following, obedient motion.

strongest_changes: The advance gift becomes costly truth before privileged speech rather than a bare fee.
Private counsel is both witnessed and ethically variable, so charity adds accountability and friction against harmful coordination.
The contrast between inability in 58:12 and nonperformance in 58:13 preserves the poor while exposing broader reluctance.
The waived one-time purification is redistributed into maintained prayer, almsgiving, obedience, and accountable work.
Later false oaths sharpen the charity into an anti-shield that joins claim to deed.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sits at a pivot from a costly threshold for private access to durable public practice; surrounding scenes of heard complaint, repaired proximity, shared space, morally divided secrecy, and deceptive speech make that pivot simultaneously social, spatial, and epistemic.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether shared-attention rationing is intended by the assembly sequence or is only a plausible adjacency-based mechanism.
How strongly أَأَشْفَقْتُمْ emphasizes protective fear versus parsimonious withholding.
Whether the dower branch and split-root course-reset image are deliberate latent resonances or only useful exploratory analogies.
